event_text: While scavenging behind a cracked wall in the ruins, three vicious stray dogs burst out from the rubble. You abandon the search immediately and sprint through collapsed beams, scrambling down a slope of broken concrete. Only when you reach the road outside do you dare look back.
You continue searching inside the ruins for usable metal scraps, moving deeper along a half-collapsed corridor as dust burns your throat and forces you to cough.
